An artist is constructing a large outdoor sculpture using metal. The table below shows four types of metal that may be used in the project. Also shown for each metal is its weight per volume, in pounds per cubic foot $(lb/ft^{3})$, and the cost per pound, in dollars.

| Metal type | Weight per volume $(lb/ft^{3})$ | Cost per pound |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Aluminum | $165$ | $$0.14$ |
| Bronze | $190$ | $$0.09$ |
| Steel | $150$ | $$0.12$ |
| Copper | $140$ | $$0.18$ |

Only aluminum, steel, and bronze will be used in the base of the sculpture. The base must weigh a total of $900$ pounds. If $285$ pounds of aluminum is used, which of the following equations could show the relationship between the amounts, $x$ and $y$, in $ft^{3}$, for each of the other two metal types used?

A nutritionist is designing a smoothie recipe using various ingredients. The table below shows four fruits that may be used. Also shown for each fruit is its weight per volume, in grams per cup $(g/cup)$, and the cost per gram, in dollars.

| Ingredient | Weight per volume $(g/cup)$ | Cost per gram |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Banana | $120$ | $$0.01$ |
| Strawberry | $150$ | $$0.02$ |
| Mango | $160$ | $$0.03$ |
| Blueberry | $100$ | $$0.04$ |

Only banana, mango, and strawberry will be used in the smoothie. The total weight must be $950$ grams. If $240$ grams of banana is used, which of the following equations could show the relationship between the amounts, $x$ and $y$, in cups, for each of the other two fruits used?
